newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Investors plan to launch Unit Trust of Pakistan.
newsitem.headline: Investors plan to launch Unit Trust of Pakistan.

text.p: A group of companies will launch Pakistan's first privately-sponsored open-ended investment company, the Unit Trust of Pakistan (UTP), next month, leading stock dealer Jahangir Siddiqui said on Monday.

He told a news conference the UTP would get seed capital of 325 million rupees, invested by Muslim Commercial Bank (MCB), Prudential Commercial Bank (PCB), Dallah AL-Baraka Group, National Bank of Pakistan and the International Finance Corporation (IFC), the private investment arm of the World Bank.
Siddiqui said full details would be published in a prospectus soon.
He said UTP would get technical support from ABAMCO Ltd, set up in 1995 as a joint venture by U.S.-based AIM Global Ventures Inc, Jahangir Siddiqui & Co, IFC and some Pakistani partners.
In the future ABAMCO would be involved in sponsoring other UTP investment schemes and distributing investment products, including those offered by AIM and other companies, he said.
